title: Barack Obama takes on 'woke' call-out culture: 'That's not activism'
summary: A Guardian clip of Barack Obama at the Obama Foundation summit saying that call-out culture is not activism and that casting stones will not bring change.
why: Cited repeatedly in threads on wokeness, cancel culture and outrage as an authoritative voice from the left criticizing call-outs.

quote.text: If all you're doing is casting stones, you're probably not going to get very far
